summary.text: A black-heaven soul path grotto-heaven led by Lady Cold Ash, with An Xun among its rank seven successors.

claims.text: Lady Cold Ash is the rank eight female immortal of Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven. She brings two rank sevens and a soul beast army of millions to Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch’s black-heaven summit on the qi-tide crisis, and she tells those nephews that they represent both themselves and Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven. She also states that Soul Pacifying Ancestor was forced to live in black heaven and that the force has already broken all ties with the five regions.

From the name and from Lady Cold Ash’s soul path practice, Spectral Soul judges that Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven is filled with abundant soul path cultivation resources. Night Heavenly Wolf Lord agrees with Lady Cold Ash that their human grotto-heavens will advance and retreat together.

Inside the grotto-heaven, Lady Cold Ash is the only rank eight and is naturally their leader. Below her are An Chong and An Xun. She steers succession toward An Xun by sending An Chong on diplomacy to Granny Skeleton, and An Chong takes immortal materials from Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven’s inventory as a meeting gift. Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven produces soul path resources useful even to Profound Literature grotto-heaven.
An Xun is already Spectral Soul’s slave while Lady Cold Ash still treats him as the nurturing target. The entire Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven, including Lady Cold Ash, is targeted by Spectral Soul.
Lady Cold Ash is named the rank eight soul path expert and owner of Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven, and Spectral Soul moves out of that grotto-heaven under her identity.
He controls Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven secretly and keeps many immemorial soul beasts there.
After escaping prior events, Spectral Soul ransacks Heavenly Court’s storage and then devours Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven, taking its entire foundation to recover strength.

Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven has over seven million soul path dao marks and contains a large number of super resource points. At the start it had only over one hundred thousand soul path dao marks. After it fused with a large nine heavens fragment, it was free from calamities and tribulations, Gu Immortals were produced generation after generation under heaven’s will’s favor, and almost all of those soul path Gu Immortals’ immortal apertures merged with the grotto-heaven after death.
